page.overview:
Who is Una MacBride?

Una MacBride is the younger sister of the G.I. Joe member Low-Light and had plans to be a model. This plan of hers, however, got her and Satin caught in a scheme by Cobra who had aligned with a repulsive individual named Madame Veil, who wished to regain her youth by stealing the faces of younger women with a device she invented, and that Serpentor wanted.
